lines.zh: 我背着弓，绕着自己的摊位走。
lines.en: I carry my bow and pace around my own stall.
The bow is on my back, the arrows at my hip.

lines.zh: 这条路我走了很多年，货物也跟着走。
lines.en: I have walked this road for years, and my goods come along.

lines.zh: 我去看看货箱有没有被动过。
lines.en: I go and check whether the crates were touched.
Soft steps, so no customer is startled.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的林子很适合埋伏。
lines.en: The Shyre woods are good ground for ambush.

lines.zh: 我沿着货摊之间的窄道走。
lines.en: I walk the narrow lanes between the stalls.
A customer is coming; I go to meet them.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是怕弓弦松了。
lines.en: I walk slowly, lest the bowstring slacken.
My quiver rattles; I press it quiet.

lines.zh: 每天这段路，我都数着走。
lines.en: I count my steps on this stretch every day.
I let another mind the stall a while.
I go round the back to look at the store.

lines.zh: 走远一点，才有货可以进。
lines.en: I walk out far, for that is where stock comes from.
I tighten the bowstring by one notch.

lines.zh: 货摊上的东西，我一件件数。
lines.en: I count the goods on the stall one by one.

lines.zh: 今天没什么客人，风倒不小。
lines.en: Few customers today, but plenty of wind.
I wipe the rust off an arrowhead.
The restock needs a while yet.
I am working out what this trip earned.
The birds in these woods are tiresome.
I lean on the post and watch the road.

lines.zh: 有支箭的羽歪了，我掰正它。
lines.en: One fletching is bent; I straighten it.
The purse is light; I must sell more.

lines.zh: 我把货摆整齐，看着舒服。
lines.en: I set the goods straight; it looks better.
This bow has been with me ten years.
I am waiting for a regular customer.
It is getting late; time to close the stall.
Are you looking at the goods or at me?
Hands off, but we can discuss the price.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把弓，用得顺手吗？
lines.en: That bow at your hip, does it serve you well?

lines.zh: 我认得你的脸，上次买过箭。
lines.en: I know your face; you bought arrows before.

lines.zh: 站远一点，你挡着我的光。
lines.en: Step back; you are blocking my light.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了塞尔瑞的土。
lines.en: Your boots carry Shyre soil.

lines.zh: 你要的东西，我这里未必有。
lines.en: What you want, I may not have.
No rush; look first, then ask the price.

lines.zh: 我的弓不是货，别打它主意。
lines.en: My bow is not stock; do not think about it.

lines.zh: 你眼睛一直往箭袋上瞟。
lines.en: Your eyes keep drifting to my quiver.
Do you want the bundle or a single arrow?

lines.zh: 这样看着我，是要还价吗？
lines.en: Looking at me like that, are you haggling?

lines.zh: 我记住你了，下次给你留货。
lines.en: I will remember you and hold stock next time.

lines.zh: 谈生意，先把手从刀上拿开。
lines.en: For business, take your hand off the blade first.

lines.zh: 你的目光落在我的弓上。
lines.en: Your eyes landed on my bow.
You name a price first. Then I'll think.
You have wrecked my stall.
After that blow I need a moment.

lines.zh: 做生意的人，不该挨这个。
lines.en: A trader should not have to take this.
My bow is on the ground.
Blood on the goods; a waste.
If you are a customer, stop hitting.
I can still stand, and we can still bargain.
I will remember this wound.

lines.zh: 我退到架子后面，喘口气。
lines.en: I fall back behind the rack to catch my breath.
The stall is ruined; I will set it up tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你手里那支箭，做工不错。
lines.en: That arrow in your hand is well made.
For this material I am willing to pay.
Let me look; do not put it away.

lines.zh: 你要是肯换，我这有更好的。
lines.en: If you will trade, I have better here.

lines.zh: 这弓弦的料，我找很久了。
lines.en: I have hunted for bowstring like this.
Put it on the table and I will study it.

lines.zh: 价钱好说，东西先给我瞧。
lines.en: Price is easy; let me see the thing first.
That whole pouch, I will take it all.

lines.zh: 别急，我不抢客人的东西。
lines.en: Easy; I do not snatch a customer's goods.

lines.zh: 这样的货，一年见不到几次。
lines.en: Goods like this appear only a few times a year.

lines.zh: 你撞翻了我的箭，捡起来。
lines.en: You knocked over my arrows; pick them up.
Do not shove; the stall will collapse.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，弓差点脱手。
lines.en: I stepped back and nearly dropped my bow.

lines.zh: 这条道窄，两个人过不去。
lines.en: This lane is narrow; two cannot pass.
Your shoulder struck my quiver.
Mind your footing; my goods are on the ground.
I caught the frame before it fell.
Make way; I need to pass and restock.

lines.zh: 撞坏了要赔的，这是规矩。
lines.en: Break it and you pay; that is the rule.
I turn aside and let you go first.
She runs the other half of the stall.

lines.zh: 我们各记一本账，晚上对。
lines.en: We each keep a ledger and compare at night.
Her aim is truer than mine.

lines.zh: 收摊后，我们一起走回去。
lines.en: After closing, we walk back together.
She saves the best goods for me.
We argued once about a price.
She counts coin faster than I do.

lines.zh: 两把弓挂在同一面墙上。
lines.en: Two bows hang on the same wall.

lines.zh: 明年我们换个更大的摊子。
lines.en: Next year we will take a bigger stall.
She walks ahead, and I carry the goods.
What falls to the ground counts as my stock.
Pick it up and I will take it off the price.
That arrow is not yours.

lines.zh: 我蹲下去，一枚一枚地捡。
lines.en: I crouch and pick them up one by one.

lines.zh: 先别动，我来分哪些是谁的。
lines.en: Hold on; let me sort out whose is whose.
The bundle you picked has a loose cord.
Once everything is gathered, we talk price.
I put it back on the rack.
Where did this coin roll off to?
Hold it properly; do not drop it.
A shadow moves at the edge of the woods.
Someone has touched my crates.

lines.zh: 那人的手一直放在刀上。
lines.en: That one keeps a hand on the blade.

lines.zh: 我听见弓弦被拉开的声音。
lines.en: I hear a bowstring being drawn.
Something circles behind the stall.
Those footsteps are not a customer's.
I touch an arrow but do not draw yet.

lines.zh: 远处有人喊价，喊得太低。
lines.en: Someone shouts a price, far too low.
They are eyeing my purse.
I take the bow down from my back.

lines.zh: 我拉开半步，站到柱子旁边。
lines.en: I shift half a step and stand by the post.

lines.zh: 他要是再走近，我就搭箭。
lines.en: One more step and I nock an arrow.

lines.zh: 先看他的手，再看他的脚。
lines.en: First his hands, then his feet.
We can haggle on price. Arrows cost extra.
Wind from the left, so I aim a little off.
I count the steps he has left.
There are two behind him.
The stall blocks me, so I change position.

lines.zh: 我不先动手，但弓已经满了。
lines.en: I will not strike first, but the bow is drawn.

lines.zh: 等他转身，那一瞬就够了。
lines.en: When he turns, that instant is enough.

lines.zh: 箭擦着他的袖子过去了。
lines.en: The arrow grazed past his sleeve.
I blocked with the body of my bow.

lines.zh: 这一箭是警告，下一支不会。
lines.en: This arrow is a warning; the next will not be.

lines.zh: 他退到摊子后面，躲开了。
lines.en: He fell back behind the stall and dodged.
I draw the bow full, and my hand is steady.

lines.zh: 箭射进木头，拔不出来了。
lines.en: The arrow is buried in the wood and will not pull free.
Do not make me fight in front of my stall.
I switch to a heavier arrow.
He took an arrow in the shoulder and ran.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，生意还得做。
lines.en: After this blow, business still goes on.

lines.zh: 我把摊子支在这条路口。
lines.en: I set up my stall at this crossing.
The goods arrived last night.
The bow goes on the wall, the arrows out front.
My first day open, and my hands shake a little.

lines.zh: 塞尔瑞的风把棚布吹得响。
lines.en: The Shyre wind snaps at my awning.

lines.zh: 我把价钱写在小木牌上。
lines.en: I write the prices on small wooden tags.
This road will bring plenty of customers.
I counted the stock three times before relaxing.

lines.zh: 有人已经在远处看着了。
lines.en: Someone is already watching from a distance.
Before opening, I tested the bow once.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到棚布，我先救货。
lines.en: Flames lick the awning; I save the goods first.

lines.zh: 我从摊架上摔下来，弓先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the rack and the bow lands first.

lines.zh: 水漫过货箱，我抓不住它。
lines.en: Water floods the crates and I cannot hold them.

lines.zh: 冲击掀翻摊子，箭撒了一地。
lines.en: The blast flips the stall and scatters my arrows.

lines.zh: 那支箭射穿了我的袖子。
lines.en: That arrow went through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 法术让我的手使不上力。
lines.en: The spell leaves my hands without strength.

lines.zh: 一天没吃东西，算账都算错。
lines.en: A day without food and I miscount the ledger.

lines.zh: 雷劈在旁边的树上，我趴下了。
lines.en: Lightning splits the tree beside me and I drop.

lines.zh: 脚下的地没了，弓也脱手。
lines.en: The ground is gone, and my bow slips away.
